$comment: The authoritative CLI command contract. Single source of truth for `themvora --help` output, the generated docs reference (apps/docs/scripts/generate-cli-reference.mjs) and shell completion. Edit here, never in a second place. JSON (not TS) so the docs script can read it without a build step.

options.description: Show help.
Show the installed version.

commands.name: generate
commands.title: Generate a Theme
commands.summary: Generate a theme from a seed, preset, or brand
commands.description: Derives a complete light + dark pair (or a single theme) from one seed color, a canonical preset, or a brand-inspired recipe.

options.description: Source hex color (#rrggbb).
Generate from a canonical preset.
Generate from a brand-inspired recipe.
Family name for the theme name.
Which mode(s) to emit.
Visual language. Seed generation only.
Contrast contract to solve for.
Also generate a tokens.code syntax palette. Seed generation only.
Write JSON to a file instead of stdout.
Print what would be written without writing it.

commands.name: list
commands.title: List Registry Entries
commands.summary: List brands, presets, styles, and frameworks
commands.description: Lists the canonical registries: brand recipes, preset recipes, generation styles, and the frameworks `init` can scaffold.

positionals.name: <selector>
positionals.description: One of: brands, presets, styles, frameworks. Omit to list every registry.

options.description: Print only the identifiers, one per line. Needs a registry selector.
Emit structured registry data instead of a human-readable list.

commands.name: validate
commands.title: Validate a Theme
commands.description: Checks a theme file against the Themvora schema, required tokens, semantic relationships, and contrast contract.

options.description: Theme file to validate (or pass it positionally).
Emit a machine-readable report on stdout.
Suppress the success summary. Errors are still printed.

commands.name: inspect
commands.title: Inspect a Theme
commands.description: Prints a human-readable summary of a theme's provenance, semantic token groups, and accessibility.

options.description: Theme file to inspect (or pass it positionally).
Show semantic token groups only.
Show resolved color tokens only.
Show generation provenance only.
Show contrast and relationship diagnostics only.
Emit the summary as JSON on stdout.

commands.name: diff
commands.title: Diff Two Themes
commands.description: Compares two theme sources and reports what changed, role by role. Every comparison decision comes from @themvora/core; this command resolves sources and renders the report.

positionals.name: <a>
positionals.description: First source: a theme file, a preset id, or a brand id. Resolved as file, then preset, then brand. Omit to use a flag instead.

positionals.name: <b>
positionals.description: Second source, resolved the same way. Omit to use a flag instead.

options.description: Use a canonical preset as a source, filling the first side without a positional.
Use a brand recipe as a source. Repeat for the other side.
Use a theme generated from this seed as a source. Repeat for the other side.
Compare only this visual mode.
Include unchanged tokens in the report.
Emit the diff report as JSON on stdout.
Print per-mode counts without the per-token rows.

commands.name: explain
commands.title: Explain a Theme
commands.summary: Explain how a theme was produced
commands.description: Explains a theme's source, recipe, identity or brand anchors, contrast contract, semantic mapping, and validation. Every value comes from an existing public API; nothing is derived.

positionals.name: <file>
positionals.description: Theme file to explain. A preset id or brand id is also accepted.

options.description: Explain a canonical preset.
Explain a brand recipe, including its pinned anchors.
Explain a theme generated from this seed.
Emit the explanation as JSON on stdout.
Omit the semantic mapping, keeping the recipe and validation.

commands.name: audit
commands.title: Audit a Theme
commands.summary: Audit a theme or the shipped presets
commands.description: Audits a theme, or every shipped preset and brand, with the canonical scorecard. Stricter than validate: it gates on the full quality model rather than the structural contract alone.

positionals.name: <scope>
positionals.description: A theme file to audit, or `presets` to audit every shipped preset and brand.

options.description: Treat warnings as failures, as the repository's preset gate does.
Emit the audit report as JSON on stdout.
Print only themes that fail or warn, plus the summary.

commands.name: doctor
commands.title: Check Project Health
commands.description: Reports the health of a Themvora project: framework, package manager, installed packages, theme configuration, and theme files. Warnings and errors are distinct, and every actionable finding carries its correction.

positionals.name: <dir>
positionals.description: Project directory to check. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Emit the health report as JSON on stdout.
Show only warnings and errors.

commands.name: init
commands.title: Create or Integrate a Project
commands.summary: Integrate Themvora into a project, or create one
commands.description: Scaffolds a new project with the framework's official generator, or integrates into an existing one, then wires the provider, the project configuration and the zero-flash bootstrap. The generated app is verified by running the project's own build and typecheck.

positionals.name: <dir>
positionals.description: Project directory. Created when it does not exist. Defaults to the current directory.

options.description: Target framework. Required for a new project; overrides detection in an existing one.
Generate the theme from a canonical preset.
Generate the theme from a brand-inspired recipe.
Generate the theme from a seed colour.
Styling engine for the generated app: `css` (plain semantic stylesheet) or `tailwind` (Tailwind v4 via @themvora/tailwind).
Package manager to use. Defaults to detection from the lockfile.
Accepted and ignored. The showcase is always generated; kept so older scripts do not break.
Print what would happen and exit. Never writes or installs.
Print the file operations and exit. Never writes, installs or scaffolds.
Skip dependency installation. Build/typecheck verification is then skipped and reported as skipped, not failed, because it needs those dependencies.
Replace files that exist and were not generated by themvora init.
Emit the plan or the report as JSON on stdout.
Suppress progress output.

exitCodes.meaning: the project was created or integrated and verified
the project was written but a verification step failed
command/runtime error, or existing files block the run

commands.name: add
commands.title: Add a Theme to a Project
commands.summary: Add a theme source to an existing project
commands.description: Adds a theme source to a project that `themvora init` already integrated. The project's generated registry records the sources it was built from, so `add` extends that list and regenerates the file — it never parses the TypeScript it wrote, and never rewrites a registry you maintain by hand.

positionals.name: <value>
positionals.description: The preset id, brand id, or seed colour.

options.description: Project directory. Defaults to the current directory.
Theme family name, for a seed source.
Generation style, for a seed source.
Print what would happen and exit. Never writes.
Print the plan and exit. Never writes.
Replace the registry even when it was not generated by Themvora.
Emit the plan or the report as JSON on stdout.
Suppress progress output.

exitCodes.meaning: the registry was updated, or already had the source
command/runtime error, or a registry that cannot be extended
usage/argument error, or no Themvora registry

commands.name: migrate
commands.title: Migrate a Theme
commands.summary: Migrate a theme to the latest format
commands.description: Migrates a legacy theme file to the current Themvora format. Nothing is written by default: the migrated theme goes to stdout, --output writes elsewhere, and --write migrates the file in place.

options.description: Legacy theme file to migrate (or pass it positionally).
Write the migrated theme to a file.
Migrate the file in place. This flag is the confirmation; without it the input is never overwritten.
Report what would change and write nothing.
Emit the migration report as JSON on stdout. Add --write or --output to persist the result.

commands.name: export
commands.title: Export a Theme
commands.summary: Export a theme to CSS or JSON
commands.description: Exports theme tokens to CSS variables or a flat JSON map.

options.description: Theme file to export (or pass it positionally).
Output format.
Write the export to a file instead of stdout.

commands.name: completion
commands.title: Shell Completion
commands.description: Prints a completion script for the given shell. Commands and flags come from this contract; registry values (presets, brands, styles, frameworks) are resolved by the script at completion time, so they cannot go stale.

positionals.name: <shell>
positionals.description: One of: bash, zsh, fish, powershell.

options.description: The shell to generate for (or pass it positionally).
